requirements.description: The supplier identifies a security contact.
The supplier has a documented incident response plan.
The supplier reviews user access at least annually.
The supplier requires multi-factor authentication for all administrator accounts.
The supplier tests restoring backups at least annually.
The supplier has a documented information security policy.
The supplier applies role-based or equivalent structured access controls to staff accounts.
The supplier has documented and implemented safeguards for remote employee workstations.
The supplier has implemented procedures for managing software dependencies and repositories.
The service supports single sign-on for users and administrators.
The service makes audit logs available covering login, logout, actions, timestamps and source IP addresses.
The service automatically locks or ends inactive sessions.
The supplier maintains a systems configuration management strategy.
The supplier scans systems and applications for vulnerabilities and remediates findings before releases.
The supplier has implemented procedures to mitigate security risks while patches are pending.
The supplier separates customer data using documented technical access controls.
The supplier encrypts sensitive data in transit using secure protocols.
The supplier encrypts sensitive data at rest.
The supplier segments trusted and untrusted networks.
The supplier assesses the security of third parties that host or receive customer data.
